summary: Feed s113_double to SIEM is degraded: 50% of packets missing required VLAN 20 (stripped/untagged) and microbursts peak at 1.62 Gbps exceeding the 1 Gbps SIEM port (162% capacity).

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or upstream trunk is stripping 802.1Q tags or not forwarding VLAN 20 - 50% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is completely absent despite SIEM requiring VLANs 10 and 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM loses segmentation context for VLAN 20; correlation, filtering and detection rules keyed to VLAN 20 fail and ~50% of traffic cannot be correctly attributed.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve/restore 802.1Q tags through the packet broker and ensure trunk forwards VLANs 10 and 20 so SIEM receives correctly tagged traffic.

findings.root_cause: Traffic microbursts peak at 1.62 Gbps in 1ms intervals, exceeding the SIEM's 1 Gbps capture port by 62% across 6 intervals - aggregate rate too high for single port.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM ingress buffers overflow and drops packets during bursts, causing missed events, incomplete flows and gaps in detection coverage.

params.alternative: filter or slice as SIEM needs_full_payload is false

recommended_fix.why: Distribute load across 2x1G ports (or add filtering/slicing) to keep per-port utilization below 80% and prevent burst drops; SIEM tolerates slicing/filtering since full payload not required.
